summary: Kittitas County 40-ft pole L-4 tower built 1934 near the valley floor; removed or destroyed 1948; photo captions show footings and an anchor; walk-in via old road 6231.

facts.status_note: Tower removed or destroyed in 1948 (sources differ); Willhite photo captions label footings and an anchor; no source describes a standing tower
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wenatchee National Forest

access.note: Walk-in on old road 6231 (about 0.3 miles) or a trail from the Fish Lake Guard Station; the Willhite page describes no closure. Public level is our inference from the directions, not a stated agency rule

visit.drive_up: Exit 80 off I-90, north through Roslyn and Ronald to Salmon la Sac, then turn right on FR 4330 toward Tucquala Lake; the road is gravel
visit.trail_note: Walk the old road 6231 about 0.3 miles (120 feet of gain per Willhite), or start from the Fish Lake Guard Station

events.note: 40-foot pole L-4 tower built near the valley floor, per the register, firelookout.com and the Willhite page

resolved_conflicts.explanation: All sources agree the tower was gone by 1948. The register says removed; firelookout.com and the Willhite page say destroyed. The year is the same in each.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: firelookout.com lists a 1933 lookout (Dave McDonald) a year before its own 1934 build date. Elevation: register and firelookout.com say 3,700 ft (1,128 m), matching the record's 1127.8 m; Willhite's access block says 3,460 ft with no stated reference point. Removed vs destroyed is disputed (1948 agreed). Willhite's earlier-lookout claim is marked unverified and kept out of the facts. Access level public is our inference from walk-in directions with no closure stated; no agency statement read. Photo captions (footings, anchor) are undated on the page. Web search turned up a different Fish Lake near Leavenworth and the Tucquala Lake area; we did not use those. No photos added. Record other_names 'Fish Lake/Clark Lake' not confirmed by any source read.
